name: D1Bound5.IsD1Tuple.all_large_retained_start
original_signature:
{K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    (a : Fin 6 → 𝓞 K) (ha : IsD1Tuple a)
    (hmon : Monotone (fun i => ‖phi (a i : K)‖))
    (hA : 3 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖) :
    let A := ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖
    let B := ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖
    let S := ‖phi (a 2 : K)‖
    let T := ‖phi (a 3 : K)‖
    let C := ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖
    let D := ‖phi (a 5 : K)‖
    A^2*T^5/S^2 < C ∧ A^2*C^5/S^2 < D ∧ A^2*C^7/(S^2*T^4) < D ∧
      1000 < C ∧ 16*B*S*T < C ∧ 1000*C < D
explicit_arguments: hK phi a ha hmon hA

name: D1Bound5.IsD1Tuple.ordinary_closed_interval_excluded
original_signature:
{K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    (t : Fin 4 → 𝓞 K) (ht : IsD1Tuple t)
    (hAB : ‖phi (t 0 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (t 1 : K)‖)
    (hAC : 1000 ≤ ‖phi (t 0 : K)‖*‖phi (t 2 : K)‖)
    (hC : 4*‖phi (t 1 : K)‖ < ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖)
    (hCD : ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (t 3 : K)‖)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hleft : ordinaryWindowLower ‖phi (t 1 : K)‖ ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖ k ≤
      ‖phi (t 3 : K)‖)
    (hright : ‖phi (t 3 : K)‖ ≤
      ordinaryWindowUpper ‖phi (t 0 : K)‖ ‖phi (t 1 : K)‖ ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖ k) :
    False
explicit_arguments: hK phi t ht hAB hAC hC hCD k hk hleft hright

name: D1Bound5.ordinaryWindowLower_succ
original_signature:
(B C : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ordinaryWindowLower B C (k+1) = ordinaryWindowLower B C k*(42*B^3*C)^2

name: D1Bound5.ordinaryWindowUpper_succ
original_signature:
(A B C : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ordinaryWindowUpper A B C (k+1) =
      ordinaryWindowUpper A B C k*(2*A*C^2/(5*B))^2

    (hCD : ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (t 3 : K)‖)

    (hstart : ordinaryWindowLower ‖phi (t 1 : K)‖ ‖phi (t 2 : K)‖ 5 ≤
      ‖phi (t 3 : K)‖) : False
